description: This file defines a plugin for processing markdown ASTs, specifically handling import directives by replacing them with imported content and removing import nodes.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a file using remark with the tableAndStrikeThrough plugin.

methods.name: plugin
methods.description: Returns the transformer function for processing ASTs.

methods.name: transformer
methods.description: Transforms the AST by replacing import directives with imported content.

methods.name: isImportNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is an import directive.

methods.name: validateImports
methods.description: Validates imported files to ensure they do not contain editable region markers.
